text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI can create art, compose music, and even write stories. Some people are amazed by this, while others feel worried. Can a machine really be creative? Human creativity comes from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, learns from huge amounts of data and finds patterns. It can produce impressive results, but it does not truly understand what it makes. Perhaps the best approach is to see AI as a helpful tool. Artists and writers can use it to get new ideas, but the heart of creativity will always remain human.
